title: Chandragupta Maurya
hook: Chandragupta Maurya: Maurya samrajya ka sansthapak
exam_points: Chanakya (Kautilya) ki madad se Nanda vansh ko haraya.
Seleucus Nicator ko c. 305 BCE mein haraya; sandhi mein Aria, Arachosia, Gedrosia, Paropamisadae mile; badle mein 500 haathi.
Megasthenes Seleucus ka rajdoot tha; usne 'Indica' likhi.
Jain parampara: antim samay Shravanabelagola (Karnataka) mein sallekhana.

mcqs.q: Megasthenes kis Maurya raja ke darbar mein aaya?
